verdict: Google profile activity is declining and has not converted to leads.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your three Google Business Profiles were the sole source of measurable activity, generating 178 total actions — primarily direction requests — with no paid advertising running. GBP engagement dropped 42% in the most recent 7 days versus the prior 7 days, and the last 4 days recorded zero actions, confirming the decline is real and not a one-day dip. The pattern across all three profiles shows visitors are largely using your listings for navigation rather than calling or clicking through, which points to a gap between profile visibility and actual lead intent. We are addressing this by building out a paid search presence to create a direct lead channel that does not depend on organic profile behavior alone. Next period, expect paid activity to be in motion and GBP figures to be benchmarked against a clearer baseline.
